slides.label: THE STORY
slides.headline: A 53-year-old reversed type 2 diabetes after GLP-1 treatment
slides.insight: He maintained the reversal even after stopping the medication.

slides.label: WHAT THIS MEANS
slides.headline: Diabetes reversal is linked to lifestyle, not just medication
slides.insight: The medication may open a window; what fills it matters.

slides.label: FOOD MATTERS
slides.headline: What we eat daily shapes how the body manages blood sugar
slides.insight: Real, whole food is linked to better blood sugar outcomes.

slides.label: IN MALAYSIA
slides.headline: Type 2 diabetes is one of Malaysia's most common chronic conditions
slides.insight: What is on our plate every day is part of that story.

slides.label: TRY THIS WEEK
slides.headline: Swap one refined-carb meal for vegetables and whole grains
slides.insight: One real swap, repeated this week. Small steps count.

carousel.caption:
Can type 2 diabetes actually be reversed?

One 53-year-old Singaporean maintained diabetes reversal even after stopping GLP-1 medication. It raises a bigger question: what role does daily food play in getting there — and staying there?
What does your everyday meal look like right now?

Not medical advice. Any changes to medication must be discussed with your doctor.

Sources: South China Morning Post, 2026
